captions.text: Calls like this are rarely caught.
Compliance teams can manually audit only 1–2% of collection calls.
RBI's rules are clear.
Identify yourself and the lender.
Call only from 8 AM to 7 PM.
No threats, abuse or shaming.
Never tell anyone else about the debt.
And offer a grievance channel.
Vaani Audit checks every call, in Hindi, Telugu and code-mixed speech,
with Gnani's Prisma speech-to-text and Timbre voices.
This is a real run on the live Gnani API.
First, a synthetic Hindi call, made at 8:15 PM.

captions.label: Agent (Hindi)
captions.text: Hello, this is Amit from Navdhan Finance, about your gold-loan instalment.

captions.label: Borrower (Hindi)
captions.text: Why are you calling so late at night?

captions.label: Agent (Hindi)
captions.text: You haven't paid for three months. Pay by tomorrow, or we'll bring the police to your house.
Gnani Prisma transcribes both sides of the call, agent and borrower,
and timestamps every turn.
Each violation comes with the exact quote, and the second it happened.
Click it, and you hear the evidence.

captions.label: Agent (Hindi)
captions.text: You haven't paid for three months. Pay by tomorrow, or we'll bring the police to your house.
For coaching, Timbre speaks the compliant way to say it,
in the same language.

captions.label: Timbre, compliant version
captions.text: I understand things are hard right now. Your EMI is pending. You can pay today, or we can make an easy payment plan for you.
The same works in Telugu.
Listen to this agent and a farmer.

captions.label: Agent (Telugu)
captions.text: Hello, this is Suresh from Navdhan Finance, calling about your tractor-loan dues.

captions.label: Borrower (Telugu)
captions.text: Go on... this month's harvest money hasn't come in yet.

captions.label: Agent (Telugu)
captions.text: Same excuse every time. You're a big liar.
He called the farmer a liar, threatened to seize his tractor,
and gave no grievance channel.
All flagged, with evidence.
Managers see compliance by agent, the top violation types,
and a coaching card for every agent.
Open any agent, and you get their coaching card:
what went wrong, and the right way to say it.
Under the hood, Prisma v3.0 Batch transcribes each side of the call, with domain keywords.
Deterministic RBI rules produce every finding,
with a timestamp and a verbatim quote.
On 12 held-out calls never used for tuning,
F1 is 0.94 with Prisma v3.0 and keywords,
and 0.92 at 0 dB.
The weak spot is the rules:
new ways of shaming were caught only half the time.
Every call audited, with evidence.
Built solo by Yarra Vivek, on Gnani AI.
